title: Docs & Writing
tagline: Craft high-fidelity specifications, whitepapers, contracts, and technical prose

cases.title: Write RFC Architecture Specification
cases.description: Structure a formal RFC with problem statement, system architecture, failure modes, and migration path.
cases.prompt: Draft a formal RFC specification for introducing end-to-end cryptographic provenance into local agent workflows.
cases.sample_output:
# RFC-042: Cryptographic Provenance in Agent Workflows

## Status: Proposed
## Author: Agent Engine Team

### 1. Abstract
This document describes an Ed25519 signing protocol for all agent-generated artifacts...

cases.title: SaaS Service Level Agreement (SLA)
cases.description: Generate rigorous enterprise SLA clauses including uptime targets, support tiers, and credit remedies.
cases.prompt: Draft an enterprise software SLA section covering 99.9% uptime commitment, maintenance windows, and tiered credit remedies.
cases.sample_output:
### 4. Service Commitment & Uptime
Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to ensure the Service maintains a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.9% during each calendar month.

cases.title: Product Requirements Document (PRD)
cases.description: Synthesize a comprehensive PRD with user personas, success metrics, edge cases, and rollout phases.
cases.prompt: Draft a comprehensive PRD for an observational memory system that learns user preferences without cloud synchronization.
cases.sample_output:
# PRD: Observational Memory Engine

## 1. Objective
Enable personalized agent responses by extracting durable user preferences from conversation turns with zero cloud data leakage.

cases.title: Commercial Partnership Proposal
cases.description: Construct an executive business proposal with value proposition, technical milestones, and governance framework.
cases.prompt: Write an executive partnership proposal presenting a co-development roadmap for edge-deployed autonomous agents.
cases.sample_output: Executive partnership proposal formatted with shared OKRs, timeline milestones, and intellectual property protections.
